description: A field declared for Fortify's login that Fortify never validates, reads or reports an error for is a Contract Coverage gap, since the declaration types a form field the server ignores.

expect.errorContains: ✗ LoginData.nickname is declared for a vendor action that never uses it (at POST /login): add a feature test that submits to POST /login with nickname, or remove it from the declaration in config/strictly.php if Laravel\Fortify\Http\Controllers\AuthenticatedSessionController@store doesn't validate or read it.
